A LETTER FROM THE FIELD 
The art of 
paying attention. 
The places that stay with us are often the quietest.
A path between trees. The edge of a lake at first light.
A room with a window open to the weather. 
This journal is an invitation to look a little longer.
We follow the soft line of a horizon and listen for
the spaces between sounds. Nothing here asks
to be hurried. There is no perfect route to take.
Take these pages as field notes, unfinished and open.
Find a place to sit. Notice the changing light.
Begin wherever you are. 
With curiosity, 
The Fieldnotes studio 
Original writing and illustrations. Made for this demo.
